entities.summary: A collection of ~970 texts discovered 1947–1956 in caves near Qumran by the Dead Sea. Dating from the 3rd century BCE to the 1st century CE, they include the oldest known copies of biblical texts and sectarian writings, revolutionizing understanding of Second Temple Judaism and textual transmission.
